title: Creamy Moroccan Sweetcorn Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup that combines the sweetness of sweetcorn with the spices of Morocco. Velvety texture adds a luxurious touch.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add sweetcorn, Moroccan spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in velvety (or heavy cream) and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
